newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Fletcher Canada confirms Timberwest sale.
newsitem.headline: Fletcher Canada confirms Timberwest sale.

text.p: Fletcher Challenge Canada said on Monday its 52 percent owned subsidiary, Timberwest Forest, had accepted a C$22 per share offer for the purchase of all of its outstanding common shares by a syndicate sponsored by Goepel Shields & Partners in cooperation with TD Securities, TD Capital Group and the Toronto Dominion Bank.
It said the syndicate had offered to purchase TimberWest for cash consideration of C$22 per share.
TimberWest has 30,640,708 shares outstanding making the total value of the share offer approximately C$674m.

In conjunction with the offer and prior to its completion, Siocan Forest Products had agreed to purchase from TimberWest its interior DB lumber operations located at Mackenzie and Williams Lake, FCL Canada said.
